summary: Verified Gemini 2.5 Flash integration end-to-end (backend + UI) plus GPT-5.2 regression. All 4 backend pytest tests pass and all 5 UI flows succeed - no 'Etwas ist schiefgelaufen' anywhere.

verification_details.backend_pytest: 4/4 pass in 48s - test_copy_gemini, test_landingpage_gemini, test_social_gemini, test_copy_gpt_regression
verification_details.model_dropdown: model-trigger reveals all three options: model-gpt (GPT-5.2), model-gemini (Gemini 2.5 Flash), model-claude (Claude Sonnet 4.5). Header label correctly switches: default 'GPT-5.2' -> 'Gemini 2.5' after selecting Gemini.
verification_details.new_brand_created: TEST_Gemini_FE_60553 via brand-new-btn/brand-save-btn, set active via active-brand-trigger -> brand-option-<id>
verification_details.gemini_copy_ui: POST /api/generate/copy {model:'gemini'} -> 200; copy-result rendered (1716 chars), no error toast
verification_details.gemini_social_ui: POST /api/generate/social {model:'gemini'} -> 200; 3 platform posts rendered, no error toast
verification_details.gpt_regression_ui: Switched model back to GPT-5.2, label updated, copy generation succeeded (1667 chars)
verification_details.gemini_backend_curl_equivalents: All three Gemini text endpoints (copy, landingpage, social) returned valid JSON with expected fields (headline, benefits[], faq[], pricing, seo, posts[])

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 865 lines - still above the 700-line threshold; recommend splitting into brands.py, generation.py, funnel.py modules.
llm_text default fallback is still MODEL_MAP.get(model_choice, MODEL_MAP['gpt']) - good, but no explicit error for unknown model strings; safe for now.

_api_key_for() correctly routes 'gemini' to GEMINI_API_KEY and 'openai' to OPENAI_API_KEY. Claude (anthropic) still uses the exhausted Emergent universal key by design (per agent_to_agent_context_note) - this is intentional.
Image generation (Nano Banana) still hardcoded to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY - will fail until Emergent budget refilled; not tested per task scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: model toggle + brand create + copy/landing/social gemini + gpt regression)
